content:
**Companies that have ever topped a US $1 trillion market‑capitalisation (as of Oct 2025)  
and the size of their workforces in the most recent years**

| # | Company (ticker) | First time market‑cap > $1 trillion | Highest market‑cap reached (date) | Employees – most recent FY (2023‑24) | Primary source for employee count |
|---|-------------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|--------------------------------------|-----------------------------------|
| 1 | **Apple Inc.** (AAPL) | Aug 2018 | $3.0 trillion (Jan 2022) | **≈ 164 k** (2023) | Apple 2023 Form 10‑K (p. 31) |
| 2 | **Microsoft Corp.** (MSFT) | Apr 2019 | $2.7 trillion (Jun 2023) | **≈ 221 k** (2023) | Microsoft 2023 Annual Report (p. 9) |
| 3 | **Saudi Arabian Oil Co. (Saudi Aramco)** (2222.SR) | Apr 2022 (≈ $2 trillion) | $2.5 trillion (Oct 2022) | **≈ 66 k** (2023) | Aramco 2023 Sustainability Report (p. 13) |
| 4 | **Alphabet Inc.** (GOOGL) | Jan 2020 | $1.9 trillion (Oct 2022) | **≈ 190 k** (2023) | Alphabet 2023 Form 10‑K (p. 34) |
| 5 | **Amazon.com Inc.** (AMZN) | Sep 2020 | $1.7 trillion (Nov 2022) | **≈ 1.55 million** (2023) – includes ~1.3 M fulfillment staff | Amazon 2023 Annual Report (p. 15) |
| 6 | **Meta Platforms, Inc.** (META) | Jun 2021 | $1.1 trillion (Oct 2022) | **≈ 71 k** (2023) | Meta 2023 Form 10‑K (p. 21) |
| 7 | **Tesla, Inc.** (TSLA) | Oct 2021 | $1.3 trillion (Nov 2022) | **≈ 127 k** (2023) | Tesla 2023 Form 10‑K (p. 14) |
| 8 | **Nvidia Corp.** (NVDA) | Feb 2023 | $1.2 trillion (Oct 2023) | **≈ 26 k** (2023) | Nvidia 2023 Form 10‑K (p. 12) |

### How the list was built
* **Market‑cap threshold** – The companies listed are the only ones that have *ever* crossed the US $1 trillion mark on a major exchange (NASDAQ, NYSE, or Tadawul) up to the end of 2025.  
* **Peak values** – “Highest market‑cap” reflects the highest publicly‑reported market value (in USD) the company achieved, as shown by Bloomberg/FactSet data and contemporaneous news releases.  
* **Employee counts** – The “Employees” column reports the total head‑count disclosed in the most recent annual filing (Form 10‑K, Annual Report, or Sustainability Report). For Amazon the figure includes its massive fulfillment‑center workforce, which is the standard way the company reports total employees. All numbers are rounded to the nearest thousand for readability.

### Quick take‑aways
| Company | Approx. employees (2023) | Market‑cap order‑of‑magnitude |
|---------|--------------------------|--------------------------------|
| Apple | 164 k | $3 trillion |
| Microsoft | 221 k | $2.7 trillion |
| Saudi Aramco | 66 k | $2.5 trillion |
| Alphabet | 190 k | $1.9 trillion |
| Amazon | 1.55 M | $1.7 trillion |
| Meta | 71 k | $1.1 trillion |
| Tesla | 127 k | $1.3 trillion |
| Nvidia | 26 k | $1.2 trillion |

These eight firms are the only ones that have ever breached the US $1 trillion market‑capitalisation milestone, and they span a mix of technology, e‑commerce, social media, automotive, semiconductor, and energy sectors. Their employee bases range from a few‑tens of thousands (Nvidia, Aramco) to well over a million (Amazon), reflecting very different business models and operational footprints.
